info.name: Yodlee Core APIs Account Token API

items.docs: The create account token service allows you to create a secure processorToken for a user's verified financial account. This processorToken can then be shared with one of our payment processor partners.

The delete account token service allows you to revoke a previously generated processorToken. It is recommended to use this service when you want to disallow further access to the user's financial account, for instance when a user removes their account from your application.
